app.name: Driveleaf
volume.label: Drive
scan.pickHint: Driveleaf only reads your disk. Nothing changes unless you ask.
mode.fastHint: Read directly from the NTFS Master File Table.
mode.slowHint: Scanned folder by folder. Folders you cannot access are missing.
mode.reopenHint: Administrator rights unlock the fast mode, which sees everything on the volume.
search.placeholder: Search by name in this scan…
column.name: Name
badge.hardLink: Hard link: this file's space is counted at another name
badge.cloud: Cloud file: not stored on this disk
badge.streams: Has alternate data streams, included in its size on disk
recycle.title: Send to the Recycle Bin?
recycle.body: “{name}” will go to the Recycle Bin, where you can still restore it.
recycle.linked: This file has other hard links, so its space stays in use until they are gone too.
recycle.done: Sent to the Recycle Bin. {size} no longer counted.
recycle.aborted: The operation was stopped before it finished.
refused.volumeRoot: The whole volume cannot be removed.
refused.notOnDisk: This entry is not a real file on disk.
refused.metafile: NTFS needs this entry to work.
refused.protected: Windows needs this item, so Driveleaf will not remove it.
refused.changed: This item changed after the scan. Scan again before removing it.
treemap.unavailable: The treemap needs WebGL2, which is not available here. The folders and lists on the left still work.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Driveleaf hit a bug it could not recover from. Your files were not touched.
